import sys
import numpy as np

def load_times(path):
    times = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            d = json.loads(line.strip())
            times.append(d["inference_time_seconds"])
    return np.array(times)

def stats(times):
    return {
        "n": len(times),
        "mean": round(float(np.mean(times)), 3),
        "median": round(float(np.median(times)), 3),
        "p5": round(float(np.percentile(times, 5)), 3),
        "p95": round(float(np.percentile(times, 95)), 3),
        "std": round(float(np.std(times)), 3),
        "total": round(float(np.sum(times)), 1),
    }

def main():
    unc_path = sys.argv[1]
    con_path = sys.argv[2]

    unc = load_times(unc_path)
    con = load_times(con_path)

    unc_s = stats(unc)
    con_s = stats(con)
